purpose: Out-of-time persistence check of the segment shortlist rule. Not a forecast of a new operator's future profit or revenue.

windows.basis: per-listing last_scraped; both windows rebuilt from raw review dates

eligibility.zero_review_listings: kept in both windows; this does not prove continuous operation

threshold.derived_from: ceil of the linear-interpolation P75 of EARLIER-window reviews among benchmark-development listings in the retained segments; fixed for both windows and every later step

candidate_rule: rank retained segments by EARLIER attainment among analysis listings, ties broken by more listings; top 3 are the candidates

smoothed_segment_rate.rule: (segment earlier positives + 10 x overall earlier rate) / (segment listings + 10); secondary only

reference_constant_prediction.note: Every listing receives the overall earlier rate; no segment information.

constant_at_recent_prevalence_for_inform.note: Uses the recent outcome itself, so it is not a fair reference; shown to size the market-wide decline.

host_weighted.note: A host counts once per group as the mean of its listings' recent outcomes in that group; a host with listings in both groups appears in both.

bootstrap.resampling_unit: analysis hosts with replacement; every listing of a drawn host enters with the host's multiplicity
bootstrap.held_fixed: threshold (34 reviews) and retained segment set (10 segments) held fixed at their point-estimate values inside every replicate

interval_A_fixed_candidates.candidates: point-estimate earlier top-3 held fixed; only attainment rates resampled
interval_A_fixed_candidates.held_fixed: threshold (34 reviews) and retained segment set (10 segments) held fixed at their point-estimate values inside every replicate

interval_B_reselected_candidates.candidates: top-3 re-selected inside each replicate from its own earlier rates (selection uncertainty included)
interval_B_reselected_candidates.held_fixed: threshold (34 reviews) and retained segment set (10 segments) held fixed at their point-estimate values inside every replicate

interval_A_fixed_candidates_host_weighte.held_fixed: threshold (34 reviews) and retained segment set (10 segments) held fixed at their point-estimate values inside every replicate

interval_B_reselected_candidates_host_we.held_fixed: threshold (34 reviews) and retained segment set (10 segments) held fixed at their point-estimate values inside every replicate

primary_not_in_validation.note: Listings with 365-730 days of review history are in the primary sample but cannot be scored in the earlier window; the validation says nothing about them.
